contract.title: Loaded upload fails before document effect
contract.intent: A source failure during one of four loaded-worker uploads causes a false document effect or contaminates sibling consumers.
preconditions: Fresh owned disposable fixture roots on distinct verified runtime processes, with origin/provider root and isolate identity witnesses.
Exact frozen runtime SHA256 62695e9e0eaec3e2a4c62279144ef42b47d60a571343356509a758f3f895853e and staged fixture/profile hashes.
Exclusive parent run slot, private IP literal endpoint, enforced wall/RSS/PID/CPU limits, readiness and owned storage teardown evidence.
Modern rpc_params_dup_stubs, native RpcStub/Symbol.dispose and native stream input/output positive controls succeed before traceEntered.
Four loaded workers each consume one gated byte stream; document1 source errors after an observed prefix.
ordered_trace: Observe four worker upload entries/prefixes and four local source pauses.
Release only document1 and require its propagated source error.
Ping the failed worker while sibling uploads remain incomplete.
Release healthy producers and verify exactly three upload effects and complete bytes.
contract.stress_dimension: Four native streams crossing loaded-worker consumers, one interrupted before effect publication.
safety_oracle: document1 receiver reports normalized premature readable disconnect, never records upload-effect, and local source has exactly one planned:source:document1 error.
Three good results carry 24576 bytes and the correct worker token; all four workers remain callable.
liveness_oracle: All advertised terminal/effect witnesses arrive before the absolute supervised 30-second case deadline.
Per-case recovery calls and exact instance identities succeed before teardown.
cleanup: Release every local and remote gate; cancel remaining readers including tee branches and queued application jobs.
Await all tracked foreground/background RPC settlements; verify provider active/pending/queued/readers all zero.
Dispose each retained callback, entrypoint and worker handle; require callback destructor count exactly one and callback active count zero.
On any hung/failed cleanup, require external supervisor teardown of only the owned fleet and storage, with PID reap evidence; no PASS credit without that evidence.

bounds.case_specific_logical_load: Four native streams crossing loaded-worker consumers, one interrupted before effect publication.

source_contracts.contract: OS dynamically loads worker code and obtains entrypoints; these tests use separate anonymous owned workers.
GitCache accepts and returns native byte streams; fixture traffic is synthetic pack-like bytes, never a claim of valid Git parsing.
Frozen native stream bridge: readable errors normalize to premature disconnect, cancellation carries its reason, writable errors propagate.

contract.identity_assumption: Loaded worker token uniqueness/stability is a frozen-native characterization, not a universal Worker Loader replacement guarantee.
contract.execution_blocker: Explicit owner overlap/authorization review required for possible overlap with separately restricted stateless-capability lifetime work; request adapter refuses B017-B024.
